dangerous_operations.why_dangerous: Deleting journal files manually will corrupt the database instance.
Dropping collections is irreversible and requires verified backups and owner sign-off.
Deleting documents does not immediately return space to the OS due to WiredTiger block management.
Generates heavy I/O and requires extra space; must only be run on secondaries one at a time.
